# Devroad

Devroad is a platform for creators, developers, and designers to sell digital products, courses, and software seamlessly.

## Key Features
- Sell digital downloads
- Accept payments easily
- Clean and minimal dashboard for creators
- Fast and responsive checkout

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Next.js API Routes, Prisma
- Database: PostgreSQL
- Payments: Razorpay (India & Global) / Stripe

## Contact
For any support or business inquiries, please reach out via our contact channels.
